observation.command: cd /workspace && docker exec -i sva-studio-postgres psql -U sva -d sva_studio -t -c "SELECT proname FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON p.pronamespace=n.oid WHERE n.nspname='graphile_worker' AND proname IN ('sva_enqueue_job','add_job');" 2>&1; echo "=== worker tables ==="; docker exec -i sva-studio-postgres psql -U sva -d sva_studio -t -c "SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='graphile_worker';" 2>&1
